record.bible_text: Woe<WH01945> to them that devise<WH02803><WTH8802> iniquity<WH0205>, and work<WH06466><WTH8802> evil<WH07451> upon their beds<WH04904>! when the morning<WH01242> is light<WH0216>, they practise<WH06213><WTH8799> it, because it is<WH03426> in the power<WH0410> of their hand<WH03027>.

And they covet<WH02530><WTH8804> fields<WH07704>, and take <FI>them<Fi> by violence<WH01497><WTH8804>; and houses<WH01004>, and take <FI>them<Fi> away<WH05375><WTH8804>: so they oppress<WH06231><WTH8804> a man<WH01397> and his house<WH01004>, even a man<WH0376> and his heritage<WH05159>. <RF>oppress: or, defraud<Rf>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Behold, against this family<WH04940> do I devise<WH02803><WTH8802> an evil<WH07451>, from which ye shall not remove<WH04185><WTH8686> your necks<WH06677>; neither shall ye go<WH03212><WTH8799> haughtily<WH07317>: for this time<WH06256> <FI>is<Fi> evil<WH07451>.

In that day<WH03117> shall <FI>one<Fi> take up<WH05375><WTH8799> a parable<WH04912> against you, and lament<WH05091><WTH8804> with a doleful<WH05093> lamentation<WH05092>, <FI>and<Fi> say<WH0559><WTH8804>, We be utterly<WH07703><WTH8800> spoiled<WH07703><WTH8738>: he hath changed<WH04171><WTH8686> the portion<WH02506> of my people<WH05971>: how hath he removed<WH04185><WTH8686> <FI>it<Fi> from me! turning away<WH07725><WTH8788> he hath divided<WH02505><WTH8762> our fields<WH07704>. <RF>a doleful...: Heb. a lamentation of lamentations<Rf> <RF>turning...: or, instead of restoring<Rf>
Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast<WH07993><WTH8688> a cord<WH02256> by lot<WH01486> in the congregation<WH06951> of the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

Prophesy<WH05197><WTH8686> ye not, <FI>say they to them that<Fi> prophesy<WH05197><WTH8686>: they shall not prophesy<WH05197><WTH8686> to them, <FI>that<Fi> they shall not take<WH05253><WTH8799> shame<WH03639>. <RF>Prophesy ye...: or, Prophesy not as they prophesy: Heb. Drop, etc<Rf>

O <FI>thou that art<Fi> named<WH0559><WTH8803> the house<WH01004> of Jacob<WH03290>, is the spirit<WH07307> of the LORD<WH03068> straitened<WH07114><WTH8804>? <FI>are<Fi> these his doings<WH04611>? do not my words<WH01697> do good<WH03190><WTH8686> to him that walketh<WH01980><WTH8802> uprightly<WH03477>? <RF>straitened: or, shortened?<Rf> <RF>uprightly: Heb. upright?<Rf>

Even of late<WH0865> my people<WH05971> is risen up<WH06965><WTH8787> as an enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>: ye pull off<WH06584><WTH8686> the robe<WH0145> with<WH04136> the garment<WH08008> from them that pass<WH05674><WTH8802> by securely<WH0983> as men averse<WH07725><WTH8803> from war<WH04421>. <RF>of late: Heb. yesterday<Rf> <RF>with the: Heb. over against a<Rf>

The women<WH0802> of my people<WH05971> have ye cast out<WH01644><WTH8762> from their pleasant<WH08588> houses<WH01004>; from their children<WH05768> have ye taken away<WH03947><WTH8799> my glory<WH01926> for ever<WH05769>. <RF>women: or, wives<Rf>

Arise<WH06965><WTH8798> ye, and depart<WH03212><WTH8798>; for this <FI>is<Fi> not <FI>your<Fi> rest<WH04496>: because it is polluted<WH02930><WTH8800>, it shall destroy<WH02254><WTH8762> <FI>you<Fi> , even with a sore<WH04834><WTH8737> destruction<WH02256>.

If<WH03863> a man<WH0376> walking<WH01980><WTH8802> in the spirit<WH07307> and falsehood<WH08267> do lie<WH03576><WTH8765>, <FI>saying<Fi> , I will prophesy<WH05197><WTH8686> unto thee of wine<WH03196> and of strong drink<WH07941>; he shall even be the prophet<WH05197><WTH8688> of this people<WH05971>. <RF>walking...: or, walk with the wind, and lie falsely<Rf><CM>

I will surely<WH0622><WTH8800> assemble<WH0622><WTH8799>, O Jacob<WH03290>, all of thee; I will surely<WH06908><WTH8763> gather<WH06908><WTH8762> the remnant<WH07611> of Israel<WH03478>; I will put<WH07760><WTH8799> them together<WH03162> as the sheep<WH06629> of Bozrah<WH01223><WTH8677><WH01224>, as the flock<WH05739> in the midst<WH08432> of their fold<WH01699>: they shall make great noise<WH01949><WTH8686> by reason of <FI>the multitude of<Fi> men<WH0120>.

The breaker<WH06555><WTH8802> is come up<WH05927><WTH8804> before<WH06440> them: they have broken up<WH06555><WTH8804>, and have passed through<WH05674><WTH8799> the gate<WH08179>, and are gone out<WH03318><WTH8799> by it: and their king<WH04428> shall pass<WH05674><WTH8799> before<WH06440> them, and the LORD<WH03068> on the head<WH07218> of them.<CM>
